How was a whole city frozen in ash for two thousand years?
In 79 AD, Mount Vesuvius erupted above the Roman city of Pompeii.
But for those who stayed, a wave of superhot gas and ash rolled down the mountain at hundreds of kilometers an hour.
Then the city was buried under meters of ash...
and forgotten for nearly seventeen hundred years.
So how do we have those famous body shapes?
In 1863, an archaeologist noticed hollow spaces in the hardened ash.
The bodies had decayed, leaving perfect molds.
and the people of Pompeii appeared again.
For years, one pair was called a mother holding her child.
But in 2024, DNA tests showed the adult was actually a man...
and not related to the child at all.
